description: This file defines the HomeController class for the SuiteCRM module, handling various AJAX-like actions for editing fields, retrieving display values, validation rules, and relate field JavaScript generation in the context of the CRM's home module.

classes.name: HomeController
classes.description: Controller class extending SugarController, responsible for handling AJAX requests related to inline editing, validation, and related functionalities within the home module.

methods.name: action_getEditFieldHTML
methods.description: Returns HTML for editing a specific field in the current module.

methods.name: action_saveHTMLField
methods.description: Saves the HTML content for a specified field in the current module.

methods.name: action_getDisplayValue
methods.description: Retrieves and echoes the display value of a specific field for a given record.

methods.name: action_getValidationRules
methods.description: Generates and returns validation rules and labels for a specific field.

methods.name: action_getRelateFieldJS
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code for relate field quick search functionality.
